name: Michael G. Grace
office: South Lyons Township Sanitary District Trustee

items.text: Michael Grace is president of the South Lyons Township Sanitary District. He was first elected to the board in 2010. As of 2020, he owned a fire and water restoration franchise and was a licensed water restoration technician. The district manages sewers in parts of Countryside, La Grange, and unincorporated Cook County. He has voted to accept the 2024 audit report and approve construction planning.
